data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [NO PHONE NUMBER](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/66575dd967de4bf4660c012c)
NO PHONE NUMBER! Trying to cancel a couple of items one business day after it was placed and nobody responds to your email. Shipping is absolutely outrageous, do not buy. 

After their response below I never heard from ANYONE, they keep shipping items I DO NOT want shipped. This is simply terrible company, nobody answers except this one answer below which did not help.

May 14, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Updated Jun 3, 2024

Hi Hally, thank you for reaching out and for sharing your feedback. We're truly saddened to hear about the issues you encountered with your order. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience that was caused by a delay in a response from our team. We can see that our Customer Experience team is assisting with your cancellation request. Your refund will be processed promptly once the cancellation is confirmed with our suppliers. Please don't hesitate to get in touch in the meantime if there's anything more we can do for you.
